validator.role: JSON Schema validation plus bounded AES cross-reference checks

findings: JSON Schema 2020-12 is sufficient for the structural architecture-realization contract; AES only needs small residual cross-reference checks.
The schema can express all nine current responsibility-shaped components and four seams without defining generic capability, workflow, provenance, policy, contract, or code-symbol semantics.
Unresolved semantic/provider/boundary decisions remain representable without inventing APIs.
Exact source revisions, nonclaims, verification obligations and disproof are enforceable structurally.
limitations: Schema validity does not prove normative applicability, provider fit, typed runtime compatibility, implementation behavior, evidence adequacy, or stakeholder utility.
The generated pilot remains a projection; accepted Markdown and accepted decisions remain current authority until an explicit migration.
No merge, Plan 001 delivery, or gap closure is claimed.
